title: Rabbi Oshaya, son of Rabbi Chiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Yevamot 46b: Rav Safra's version names Rabbi Oshaya, son of Rabbi Chiya. Rashi explains that he was with Rabbi Oshaya Berabbi and with Rabbi Chiya. Were it not for Rashi's explanation, it would appear to refer to Rabbi Oshaya Berabbi, who was with Rabbi Chiya. See there.

notes.text: The consulted Rashi describes an additional Oshaya son of Chiya alongside Oshaya Berabbi and Chiya. Hyman offers a different reading. Berabbi is retained as a designation without identifying its bearer as a son of Yehudah HaNasi.
The consulted Rashi on Yevamot 46b distinguishes the additional Oshaya son of Chiya in Rav Safra’s version. Hyman’s alternative stays conditional.
